newsitem.title: BELGIUM: New cases of swine fever uncovered in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: New cases of swine fever uncovered in Belgium.

text.p: Belgium's outbreak of swine fever has struck in new areas, forcing the agriculture ministry to reinstate emergency measures it had only just relaxed, French-language newspaper La Libre Belgique said on Saturday.
The new cases, announced by the ministry late on Friday, are outside quarantine areas set up earlier in the week in the wake of initial discoveries of the higly contagious disease.
Belgian Agriculture Minister Karel Pinxten said on Thursday the outbreak had spread from one farm to six and predicted that contamination of others was highly likely, .
Belgium, a large producer of pork-based products, has already started an extensive slaughter programme to contain the highly contagious disease in the north of the country.
Further measures will include the imposition of animal transport bans in affected areas, said La Libre Belgique, which added that local economies were already feeling the effects of the outbreak.
Belgium has about seven million pigs.
